purpose: TEMPLATE: export-creature.mjs --brief input for a Quest 3 composer creature export (creature export v2, docs/creature-export-v2.md). It sets the target device, the level-0 triangle budget and the LOD count; the exporter writes a per-creature brief with the measured numbers next to each GLB.

artDirection.summary: Stylised procedural animal from the universe-atlas fauna composer: one skinned vertex-coloured mesh per LOD level, composer skeleton, baked motion clips.

visual: animal intact at normal viewing size at every LOD level
no skinning tears while the clips play
technical: quest-3 budget: level 0 at most 8000 triangles, at most 80 joints, 1 material, 1 draw call per level; LOD levels at most 8000 / 3000 / 1000 triangles; an export over budget fails with exit code 3 and writes nothing
clips match poseComposer at their keys (crossfaded loops: outside the blend)
runtime: experimental until an in-headset check on Quest 3 passes

provenance.prompt: TEMPLATE: the recipe text of each exported creature is its whole input; the per-creature brief written by the exporter carries it.

restrictions: Template only; each exported creature carries its own provenance. Licence open until the owner answers the creature-kit licence question.

provenance.notes: Procedural; no external inputs (no model checkpoint, texture, scan or third-party asset). The brief may tighten the quest-3 profile budget (8000 triangles, 80 joints, 1 material, 4 MiB textures, 1 draw call per level) but never loosen it.
